description: Dry-run-only v0.9.0 approval preview plan for admin review, command approval, rollback state, and blocked real-run UX. It does not contain real installer commands.

commands.description: LOW risk preview command used to demonstrate an allowed dry-run approval item.
commands.expectedResult: Shows a harmless LOW risk preview message.
commands.rollbackNote: No rollback is required because this command does not modify system state.

commands.description: MEDIUM risk placeholder showing that approval review blocks non-low risk command execution.
commands.blockedReason: MEDIUM risk commands are blocked in the v0.9.0 desktop approval preview.
commands.expectedResult: Visible as a blocked preview item only.
commands.rollbackNote: Rollback is not executed because the command is blocked before real execution.

commands.description: HIGH risk placeholder showing orange high-risk visual treatment.
commands.blockedReason: HIGH risk commands are blocked in the v0.9.0 desktop approval preview.
commands.expectedResult: Visible as a blocked preview item only.
commands.rollbackNote: Rollback is not executed because the command is blocked before real execution.

commands.description: ADMIN_REQUIRED placeholder demonstrating admin permission review without triggering UAC.
commands.blockedReason: Admin-required commands are visible but blocked; the UI must not auto-elevate.
commands.expectedResult: Visible as an admin-blocked preview item only.
commands.rollbackNote: Rollback requires operator planning and is not executed by this preview.

commands.description: DANGEROUS placeholder showing red blocked state and non-executable command preview.
commands.blockedReason: DANGEROUS commands are blocked and must never be encouraged by one-click UI.
commands.expectedResult: Visible as a dangerous blocked preview item only.
commands.rollbackNote: Rollback is unavailable for dangerous preview items.

adminReason: The plan includes admin-required preview items, so the UI must explain sensitivity without requesting elevation.
approvalSummary: This plan demonstrates command-level approval, admin review, rollback review, and blocked real-run state for v0.9.0.
rollbackPlan: Rollback is documented as an operator-reviewed plan. The desktop UI does not run rollback commands in v0.9.0.
rollbackWarning: Some blocked commands have no proven rollback. Real execution stays disabled.
permissionReview: Review admin reason, command risk, approval state, rollback coverage, and audit/report visibility before any future controlled run.
blockedReason: The plan contains admin-required and higher-risk preview commands; real installation is disabled.
expectedResult: Desktop UI shows approval states only. No real third-party installer command is executed.
rollbackNote: Rollback state is displayed for review only.
notes: All commands are harmless preview placeholders.
This plan exists for local self-test of v0.9.0 approval UX.
Real installation, UAC elevation, PATH edits, proxy edits, and global environment edits remain disabled.
